description: MOM6 in layered (isopycnal) mode, without ALE regridding. There are 63 layers: a 2-layer bulk mixed layer and 2 buffer layers at the top, over 59 isopycnal layers in the interior. Target potential densities (sigma-2) range from 1009.42 to 1038.30 kg m-3. Layer thicknesses vary in space and time, and interior layers can have near-zero thickness where their density does not occur. The model is Boussinesq; "hybrid-pressure-isopycnic" was chosen as the closest option, since there is no option for a pure isopycnic coordinate with a bulk mixed layer.
